subject.title: fix(acp): preserve legacy replay state during doctor repair

question: Should the protected ACP replay migration land once the branch is refreshed and the exact merge candidate passes the focused upgrade and replay gates?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound and proven, but it changes the only upgrade path for persisted ACP replay state, so accepting that compatibility and session-state boundary requires explicit human ownership.

options.title: Land after merge-head verification
options.body: Refresh onto current main and merge after the focused migration tests, database-first guard, Kysely guard, and real Doctor upgrade proof pass on the exact candidate.

options.title: Pause for additional upgrade cases
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers want another legacy-ledger shape or crash point exercised before accepting the migration boundary.

recommendation.title: Land after merge-head verification
recommendation.body: Refresh onto current main and merge after the focused migration tests, database-first guard, Kysely guard, and real Doctor upgrade proof pass on the exact candidate.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main ACP robustness and event-ledger work make Sofus the strongest available routing candidate for replay-runtime invariants.
